resources.name: Monte Carlo electron transport code (EGS5, Geant4, PENELOPE, or equivalent)

access.notes: Any open-source Monte Carlo electron/photon transport code is acceptable. Examples: EGS5 (https://www.slac.stanford.edu/egs/), Geant4 (https://geant4.web.cern.ch/), PENELOPE (https://www.oecd-nea.org/tools/abstract/detail/nea-1525). The agent must obtain and install one.

resources.notes: The code must be obtained by the agent. The geometry and material parameters are provided in the instructions, not as a separate resource.
